Score against cost

The same tools and filters as the leaderboard, drawn as score against compute time. The line joins the tools that no other tool beats on both: none is both cheaper and better. Colour is the kind of method; within a kind, marker shape is the tool, and for kmerseek the alphabet. Peak memory is not on this figure; it is in Table 1.

The benchmark split the proteins along one of the last four rows at a time, so picking a value in one of them sets the other three back to "any".
